issues.quote: It is an old joke in the house, and I would rather not repeat it now.
issues.fact: L2 says only that the master said what he always says about the hall clock. It gives no sense that the clock is a known joke or habitually wrong.
issues.misreading: A solver could read this as a sign that the hall clock is chronically inaccurate, so the 9:48-regulator-versus-10 o'clock-hall-strike discrepancy is an expected quirk to be dismissed rather than a measured reading.

issues.quote: I set its beat myself, most of it.
issues.fact: The sheet says nothing about who adjusted the regulator. It only says the regulator agreed exactly with the temple bell at ten.
issues.misreading: A solver could infer that the witness has personal control over the regulator's accuracy, which adds a hint about her access and reliability that the sheet does not give.

issues.quote: Mine was exact, and he said so, which he did not say often.
issues.fact: L1 says only that her watch was exact. It does not say the master commented on it.
issues.misreading: The added remark about the master's praise is extra characterisation, which could be read as a further hint about the watch's trustworthiness or the master's habits.

issues.quote: I regulated it myself. I have never trusted anyone else with it, and I do not intend to start now.
issues.fact: The sheet makes no statement about who regulated her own watch.
issues.misreading: The added claim that she regulates her own watch is an unsupplied fact about her watch's reliability and her own hands on it, which a solver could use as a clue.

issues.quote: When you press the slide, it gives the hours in low notes. Each quarter is a doubled note. Then the minutes past the quarter come in high notes, one for each minute.
issues.fact: The sheet contains no description of the repeater's striking pattern, and no repeater sounding is attached to any event or reading.
issues.misreading: This supplies an unstated method for deriving a time from sound, so a solver could try to read a time off a repeater that the sheet never places anywhere in the timeline.
